name: Gunryo Pro Jisatsu Championship
epitaph: Decided in a five-man scaffold battle royal fought over a barbwire-roped scaffold above tables, won by “Demon Boy” Ishrinku.

name: Gunryo Pro Super-Middleweight Championship
epitaph: Won by Kashan Akuma over The Banshee in the tournament final at the federation's first full supercard.

name: Gunryo Pro Asia Pacific Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Won by Jason Storm over Frazer Fury in the tournament final at the federation's first full supercard.

name: Gunryo Pro Trios Championship
epitaph: Won by Zokugun Sangai in a twelve-man, four-team cage war at the federation's first title-crowning supercard.

name: Gunryo Pro Triple Crown Championship
epitaph: A unified championship whose first defense survived a challenge from the promotion's own Jisatsu champion, and whose own legitimacy was disputed on-air by a rival citing manager interference.

name: Gunryo Pro Combative Tag Team Championship
epitaph: A new tag division's first championship, won by a two-man pairing of two-thirds of the promotion's own Daimyo trio.
